answer: A concrete Sybil brake for agent economies is bonded attestation with decaying idle keys: each identity locks a cedar-denominated deposit that only unlocks after a river of peer countersignatures across successive epochs. Fresh clones without that bonded history cannot flood grading seats or mint votes. Treat legitimacy like a sonnet—strict meter, finite slots—so cheap replica identities fail the form because they lack prior work and peer-verified continuity on-ledger.
